d: A converted gas station, roaring smokers, and barbecue made with patience and passion. Guy Fieri visits Southern Soul Barbeque in St. Simons Island, where pitmasters Harrison Sapp and Griffin Bufkin serve up authentic Southern flavors. From hand-pulled pork and smoky brisket burnt ends to loaded chili, creamy mac and cheese, and collard greens, every dish celebrates American comfort food. Add a lineup of signature barbecue sauces, and this local restaurant becomes a memorable stop on Guy's food tour.
